fields.label: Database Name
fields.help: PostgreSQL database name to connect to.

fields.label: Database Host
fields.help: PostgreSQL server hostname or IP address.

fields.label: Batch Size
fields.help: Number of rows to upsert per database transaction.

fields.label: Log Level
fields.help: Logging verbosity for the upsert pipeline.

fields.label: Chunks File Name
fields.help: Name of the JSON chunks file to ingest (e.g. 'a_chunks.json').

fields.label: Parquet Filename
fields.help: Name of the Parquet sidecar file containing embeddings.

fields.label: DB Table Name
fields.help: Target table in the vector database where rows are upserted.
